name: orbit-waypoint
description: Waypoint Group delivery operations platform — Tech-Triathlon 2026

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm test -w apps/web && npm test -w apps/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && BROWSER_E2E=1 node apps/api/test/planning.integration.cjs --postgres
scripts.typecheck: npm run test:contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test:demo: npm run build && DEMO_BROWSER_E2E=1 node apps/api/test/planning.integration.cjs --postgres
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run build && BROWSER_E2E=1 STORE_BROWSER_E2E=1 DISPATCHER_UI_E2E=1 DEMO_BROWSER_E2E=1 node apps/api/test/planning.integration.cjs --postgres
